values.note: Closed: the Forest Service took over the campground from the concessionaire on 2026-11-01 and closed it 'while we assess and address health and safety concerns' (no reopening date). Nacimiento-Fergusson Road and the campground are also inside the Monterey Ranger District emergency closure (Timber and Plaskett fire areas), Forest Order 05-07-51-26-11, effective until 2027-01-31.

status.source: FS Nacimiento page banner (last updated 2026-11-03) and Forest Order 05-07-51-26-11 (Exhibit C: 22S01 Nacimiento-Fergusson, 22S01B Nacimiento Campground), read 2026-11-26

values.note: First-come: pay at the fee tube or the host.

booking.source: FS page ('pay via fee tube or via host'; '14 day maximum stay'; Forest Service-run since 2026-11-01, so the concessionaire's campone.com passes no longer apply) and a recreation.gov search finding no campground facility for Nacimiento (AWH 2026-10-22: no rec.gov listing = first-come only), read 2026-11-26

fees.source: FS page ('$30.00 per site per night ... One car is included with the price of the campsite. Additional vehicles are $10.00 per vehicle per night.'), read 2026-11-26

sites.source: FS page ('Small campground with 8 campsites'; 'Recreational Vehicles no longer than 25 feet recommended'), read 2026-11-26

note: Small Los Padres NF campground in oak groves beside a running creek on Nacimiento-Fergusson Road, a long, winding mountain drive from US-101 (via Fort Hunter Liggett) or Highway 1. --Claude
summary: Nacimiento (Los Padres NF): now Forest Service-run (concession ended 2026-11-01) and CLOSED - status temporarily_closed (management closure, no date; also inside Forest Order 05-07-51-26-11 to 2027-01-31); booking operator/reservable -> first-come only (no rec.gov listing; fee tube/host), 14-night max; fees $30 + $10 extra vehicle confirmed; 8 sites, RVs to 25 ft recommended confirmed; vault toilets cleared (FS: 'Restrooms are not available').
